name: @jiscribe/plugin-general-shapes
description: Provides, as an external package built on the public canvas API alone, general-purpose pictograms that belong to no notation and stand for things, people and places (15 of them: actor / cloud / server / browserWindow and so on). Decorative shapes (star / heart / banners and the like) are out of scope (packages/canvas/docs/13-authoring-plugins.md)
